description: A track whose file size equals the threshold exactly is included.

d.request: Among tracks with Bytes >= 10323804 (threshold inclusive, excluding NULL Bytes), what is the average UnitPrice and the average of Bytes/Milliseconds (as a non-rounded decimal ratio) across those tracks?
d.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track WHERE Bytes >= 10323804;

b.request: For tracks with `Bytes >= 10323804` (NULL `Bytes` excluded), return the average `UnitPrice` and the average of `CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds`, unrounded.
b.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track WHERE Bytes >= 10323804;
b.raw: For tracks with `Bytes >= 10323804` (NULL `Bytes` excluded), return the average `UnitPrice` and the average of `CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds`, unrounded.

c.request: Taking 10323804 bytes as the cutoff for a large track, what is the average `UnitPrice` of the large tracks and their average bytes per millisecond (`Bytes` divided by `Milliseconds`, as a decimal ratio)? Ignore missing values and don't round. A track whose file size equals the threshold exactly is included.
c.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(Bytes * 1.0 / Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Bytes >= 10323804

a.request: For tracks with a file size (`Bytes`) of at least 10323804, what is the average `UnitPrice` and the average bytes per millisecond (`Bytes` divided by `Milliseconds`, as a decimal ratio)? Ignore missing values and don't round.
a.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track WHERE Bytes >= 10323804;
